dedupe_keys.name: bornes de recharge pour vehicules electriques

description: Bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Ce jeu de données présente les données relatives à la localisation géographique et aux caractéristiques techniques des stations et des points de recharge ouverts au public pour véhicules électriques. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Transport, Mobility. Its keywords are vehicule, électrique, borne, energie, DIMENC, recharge. The portal shows 56 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
